Blue Jays pitcher Trey Yesavage married his college sweetheart, and the wedding photos are gorgeous

Nisean Lorde
November 23, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:40
Instaread

Love is in the air for another Toronto Blue Jays player! First, Ernie Clement got engaged to his longtime girlfriend Stefanie Brejcha earlier this year, and now beloved pitcher Trey Yesavage has officially traded the pitcher’s mound for the altar.

The 23-year-old baseball star married his longtime love, Taylor Frick, on Saturday, Nov. 21, and shared some super sweet photos of the couple’s big day, captioning the Insta album, ‘a lifetime of choosing us. 11.21.2026′!

The wedding comes just over a year after the couple announced their engagement in November 2025, shortly after the Blue Jays’ World Series loss to the Los Angeles Dodgers.

Yesavage proposed to Frick on a beach at sunset, and the couple shared photos of the romantic moment on Insta, including a close-up of Frick’s sparkling diamond engagement ring.

“In this lifetime & the next, it will always be you,” Frick captioned the announcement.

The Pennsylvania-born pitcher met Frick, a Maryland native, while they were both attending East Carolina University in Greenville, North Carolina. Frick has been by his side throughout his rise in pro ball, including the Jays’ 2025 World Series run.

During Game 5 against the Dodgers, Yesavage made history by striking out 12 batters, setting a World Series record for a rookie pitcher and helping Toronto move within one win of the championship.

His 2026 season was a bit more challenging, with shoulder and knee injuries disrupting his campaign. He finished the year with a 5-6 record, a 3.69 ERA and 97 strikeouts across 20 starts.

But who knows what comes next for the pitcher? If he’s following in former Jays player George Springer’s footsteps, perhaps a baby carriage!
